verdict.rationale: CrewAI has a `crewai test` CLI command that runs the crew for N iterations and reports performance metrics, which could be wired into CI, plus observability docs on tracking execution times and token usage — but there is no evidence of built-in quality/accuracy 'evals' (scoring correctness, task success, groundedness, etc.) or of first-class CI integration/examples. missing for 10: dedicated eval/scoring framework (accuracy, task success, groundedness metrics), CI pipeline examples/integration guides, pass/fail thresholds or regression gating, independent evidence of using `crewai test` in CI.
